about: What the Ouro AX X-ray (ouro-ui-apple, pinned in Package.swift) proves about Spoonjoy's App Intents on every pull request: the metadata of the iOS app the App bundle job builds. scripts/check-xray.rb holds the report to this file. Claims under hold must hold; failing claims are known gaps with an owner; open claims can't be settled in this lane, and each says why.

open.intent.tool: needs the Xcode 27.3 SDK: earlier metadata cannot mark tool intents. The tools are marked behind the 27.3 fence in Apps/Spoonjoy/Shared/Native/SpoonjoySiriToolIntents.swift, which no CI image can compile yet
open.intent.error-names-fix: behaviour stage, refusal runs: only against a disposable device and backend (--disposable), and BootstrapDebug talks to production
open.intent.confirms-what-others-see: a person: run the delete, remove, revoke and disconnect intents in Shortcuts and Siri and check each asks first
open.intent.reads-in-shortcuts: a person: read each intent's summary in the Shortcuts action library
open.intent.siri-calls: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.intent.siri-says-what-happened: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.entity.property-description: needs the Xcode 27.3 SDK: earlier metadata carries no property descriptions. Every entity property has one behind the 27.3 fence
open.entity.private-properties: a person: check that no property says more than its owner would share; ids, routes, credential ids and key prefixes are left out on purpose
open.entity.indexed: behaviour stage: the main-only App Intents behaviour job (iOS 27.1 simulator, signed out, so there is nothing to index)
open.entity.ids-resolve: behaviour stage: the main-only App Intents behaviour job; signed out, there is nothing to look up
open.entity.transfer-round-trip: behaviour stage: the main-only App Intents behaviour job
open.entity.display-representation: a person: find each entity in Spotlight and Shortcuts and check its title, subtitle and image
open.entity.siri-finds: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.annotation.onscreen: behaviour stage: the main-only App Intents behaviour job
open.annotation.siri-onscreen: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.skill.loads: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 OS on an Apple Intelligence device
